CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to identified content organization/emergence/access.

COD.rationale: For p0/current/n0 the content (red coordinates) and a separate organization/access status (origin metadata) are both explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the same content's organization/presentation/access; candidate/command labels alone are insufficient.

C.rationale: Multiple nodes explicitly list identified content with attributes (color) and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from origin/representation metadata, distinguishing identification from organization/access status.

O.rationale: The report states how content records are represented/accessed (origin/represented_time) and gives display mapping (rows/columns).
